caption: The drawing depicts a single, conical, ribbed object that appears to be a coiled structure resembling a traditional beehive or a woven basket with a hole near its base and a circular opening at the top. The object is rendered in shades of brown, with darker brown shadows between the ridges and a slightly lighter, reddish-brown interior around the top opening. The surface texture is depicted with parallel horizontal lines following the conical shape, suggesting a coiled or spiral construction. The background is an off-white or cream color, blank except for a fine rectangular border framing the drawing and some handwritten text and numbers in the lower corners. The artist’s name, “Yolande DeLasser,” is written in small letters near the bottom left of the rectangular border.
title: Roach Trap
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
